soft_capture_times.name: Four moments, one recipe
soft_capture_times.description: Four captures from the existing vessel simulation. Trigger the black point or CHANGE to compare another set of stop times.
interactions: Nearby CHANGE and RESET push buttons
Grabbable black PointBody; trigger or drag as labelled
soft_capture_times.qfep_connection: The retained shape depends on the sampling decision; display and force conditions are made separately adjustable.

soft_sampled_gallery.name: From the soft body gallery
soft_sampled_gallery.description: Six actual gallery configurations, three at a time. Compare starting and captured geometry with the same framing. Cloth, lattice, branch, CA threads and two mould experiments.
interactions: POSE or held PointBody trigger switches start / captured geometry
soft_sampled_gallery.qfep_connection: Conditions and the sampling moment leave a shape; the saved sculpture does not retain the capacity to resume the process.
